Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Service.File.PassthroughService
Class.Description: Accepts files from the File Inbound Adapter, encapsulates each one as a Stream object within a StreamContainer object and forwards the container object to the configured target configuration item or items.

Property.name: TargetConfigNames
Property.Description: Configuration item(s) to which to send file stream messages

Method.name: OnProcessInput
Method.Description: Wrap the input stream object in a StreamContainer message object and send it. If the adapter has a value for ArchivePath, send async; otherwise send synchronously to ensure that we don't return to the Adapter and let it delete the file before the target Config Item is finished processing it.

Method.name: resolveAndIndex
Method.Description: Initialize and perform requested validation if any

Method.name: OnGetConnections
Method.Description: Return an array of connections for drawing lines on the config diagram
